items.title: Vince Lateano interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002
items.q: And I guess I started playing with Vince Guaraldi sort of immediately after I wasn’t here that long and I started doing some stuff with him.

ctx.x: I started — you move someplace and you’re at the bottom of the list. Because I didn’t know that many people here. And I guess I started playing with Vince Guaraldi sort of immediately after I wasn’t here that long and I started doing some stuff with him. And that helped. I didn’t play on a regular basis but I used to play — he’d change things around, he was trying different stuff.
Was this — I’m trying to remember when he had his kind of hit with “Cast Your Fate to the Wind.”
